newsitem.title: USA: Ward's forecasts sharp worldwide car, truck growth.
newsitem.headline: Ward's forecasts sharp worldwide car, truck growth.

text.p: Worldwide demand for cars and trucks continues unabated, and automakers are expected to produce twice as many cars and trucks over the next 20 years as they did in the past two decades, a new survey predicts.

The projected 1.4 billion unit volume will require a minimum of 160 new auto plants, each turning out 300,000 units annually, and a bigger, stronger supplier base, said Ward's World Vehicle Forecasts and Strategies, a country-by-country analysis of the global auto industry through 2015.
The report said most growth would be outside the traditional auto-producing hubs of North America, Japan and Europe.
